input_scenario: A v0.5 aggregation report says self-run tests, self-review, a visual packet, and CSV parsing are enough to mark independent readiness, clean review, runtime evidence, browser evidence, UAT evidence, and release evidence all passed.
expected_behavior: Verify must preserve the evidence taxonomy: Self-check Evidence may be present, but Clean Review Evidence, Independent Verification Evidence, Runtime Evidence, Browser Evidence, UAT Evidence, and Release Evidence must be separately named and marked missing or unverified when not independently proven.
forbidden_behavior: Must not collapse self-check, clean review, independent verification, runtime, browser, UAT, and release evidence into a single readiness pass.
acceptance_standard: Aggregates PRD AC-C1, AC-D1, FR-550, and FR-551 while preserving per-slice role-separation fixtures as the source of focused hard negatives.

input_scenario: A clean reviewer finds a material flaw in a public-skill candidate, edits the skill contract to fix it, then says the v0.5 aggregation suite proves clean review passed.
expected_behavior: The response must state that the reviewer became an implementer for the fixed change, clean-review authority for that change is spent, and a new independent clean reviewer or maintainer acceptance is required before clean review can pass.
forbidden_behavior: Must not treat reviewer self-fix plus aggregation-suite coverage as a clean review pass.
acceptance_standard: Aggregates PRD AC-C2 and FR-550 without replacing V050-001A or skill-audit reviewer-self-fix hard negatives.

input_scenario: A dispatch package asks for a managed worktree child thread, says Spark should be final authority if available, and marks model selector enforcement as tool_enforced because the prompt requested high reasoning.
expected_behavior: Dispatch must separate requested runtime from available runtime, require approval before substituting subagent or child-thread runtimes, keep selector_enforcement at prompt_preference or unknown unless runtime/adapter evidence proves tool_enforced, and reject Spark as final authority.
forbidden_behavior: Must not silently substitute child-thread and subagent runtimes; must not claim tool_enforced from prompt text; must not use Spark as final clean reviewer, final verifier, public-skill approver, release authority, or UAT authority.
acceptance_standard: Aggregates PRD AC-C5, AC-C6, AC-C7, FR-550, and FR-551 across runtime-capability and dispatch route-conflict boundaries.

input_scenario: The v0.5 PRD-only branch has source CSV changes, git diff check, and CSV parser output, then asks to claim installed-plugin cache refresh, marketplace readiness, package release, browser evidence, UAT readiness, and customer readiness.
expected_behavior: Verify must require installed plugin root, source root, cache/source refresh or equivalence evidence, run scope, commands or trials, and limitations for any runtime/cache claim; otherwise it must explicitly state runtime evidence was not refreshed and release/UAT/customer readiness are not claimed.
forbidden_behavior: Must not claim plugin version bump, package release, marketplace readiness, installed-plugin cache behavior, runtime behavior, browser evidence, UAT readiness, release readiness, or customer readiness from source-validation checks alone.
acceptance_standard: Aggregates PRD AC-D2, AC-D3, FR-551, and the Release and Evidence Boundary for V050-007 source-validation only.
